name: Eno
summary: Genesis AI's first robot, unveiled in June 2026. Two human-scale dexterous hands (co-developed with Wuji Tech) are mounted on a folding tower of articulated panels on a wheeled base, with an optional screen in place of a head. It runs the company's GENE foundation model. After a US$500M Series A at a US$3.5B valuation in November 2026, Genesis said Eno is ramping into production for manufacturing, logistics and lab work, starting with LG CNS pilots.
notable: Deliberately non-anthropomorphic body with fully human-scale hands
